name: Ember Squall
description: Strike with a palm that carries a squall of qi with hot embers glowing in its core.

name: Smoke Guard
description: Wreathe the arms in thick warm smoke and wind that takes the edge off a blow.

name: Sear Step
description: Step forward on a hot rising gust that leaves a scorched mark on the ground.

name: Ember Drizzle
description: Flick a spray of glowing cinders carried on rain qi that sting and burn where they land.

name: Scald Lash
description: Whip a scalding wet gust across the opponent's arm so that his grip and his nerve fail.

name: Heat Veil
description: Spin a veil of hot wind and steam about the body that warps and weakens strikes.

name: Burning Downpour
description: Call a downpour of burning rain onto the field that scalds and chars all that stand in it.

name: Blaze Draft
description: Turn a blow with a blast of hot wind and return a burning strike through the opening.

name: Flame Thunderhead
description: Raise a thunderhead lit from within by fire and drop it on the target as a burning crash.

name: Cinder Tempest
description: streams: Storm + Fire; join the burning stream to the storm stream so a tempest of flame and thunder falls and spreads.

name: Rime Palm
description: Strike with a palm rimed in frost so that the squall's weight lands as bitter cold.

name: Hoar Guard
description: Wrap the forearms in thick hoarfrost and wind that chips a blow into splinters.

name: Frost Hop
description: Skip lightly over the ground on a gust that freezes a thin skin where the foot lands.

name: Icicle Cast
description: Cast a long icicle of storm qi from the hand that is driven by a hard gust.

name: Frozen Rain
description: Throw a hard slant of freezing rain across the front that numbs and cuts all it touches.

name: Chill Bind
description: Freeze a wet cord of qi about the opponent's legs and hold him to the ground.

name: Sleet Parry
description: Sweep a sheet of icy sleet before the blow so that it slips and glances aside.

name: Thaw Rinse
description: Pass a thawing warm rain over an ally to draw frostbite and numbing cold from the body.

name: Hailstorm Barrage
description: Rain great stones of hail onto the field from the gathered cloud in a thundering volley.

name: Whiteout Veil
description: Fill the near air with blinding snow and wind so that attackers lose the user among white.

name: Rime Maelstrom
description: Spin a maelstrom of frost and rain over the field that drags foes in and freezes them solid.

name: Frostbound Tempest
description: streams: Storm + Ice; fuse the ice stream into the tempest so wind and thunder fall as a driving frozen ruin.

name: Tremor Fist
description: Punch the ground-bound target with a fist that sends a tremor along with the storm qi.

name: Tremor Guard
description: Set the feet and let a tremor of earth qi through the legs absorb the force of a blow.

name: Rumble Stride
description: Stride forward with each foot falling like a muffled peal that rolls in the ground.

name: Shard Cast
description: Cast a shard of stone wrapped in lightning qi from the palm that cracks as it flies.

name: Grounding Bolt
description: Call a bolt down through the ground at the target's feet so it surges up through his body.

name: Tremor Lock
description: Shake the ground into a sucking mire of stone and lightning that grips the opponent's legs.

name: Shake Parry
description: Stamp so that a shock leaps up and knocks the oncoming strike out of true.

name: Silt Cleanse
description: Draw poison and taint out of an ally through the soles into the ground and let rain wash it off.

name: Thunder Quake
description: Drive a peal of thunder deep into the earth so that the ground heaves under all near the user.

name: Stone Squall
description: Stand a rotating wall of grit and stone and wind about the body to take heavy blows.

name: Rooted Lance
description: Send a lance of rooted lightning up from below to pierce guards that are set against the front.

name: Tectonic Thunder
description: Break thunder against the ground and heave a slab of earth up into the target in one crushing blow.

name: Rooted Lightning
description: streams: Storm + Earth; root the lightning in the earth stream so one bolt pierces from beneath and cannot be turned.

name: Quaking Tempest
description: streams: Storm + Earth; shake the ground under a full tempest so the quake and the storm tear the field together.
